# OLYMPUS v0.0.22 build sheet (as written before the build, 2026-11-16, with §15 added after it)

> The round's build sheet kept whole as the contract the roles built to; **§15, as built, wins over any line above it that it contradicts.** DESIGN.md's log of 2026-11-18 carries the decisions. Where the code and a line below disagree, the code decides.

# OLYMPUS v0.0.22, "Stack and clear: eight rooms, a lane that ends when it is done, and walls between you and your own grenade": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-16 for the round's four implementers (A, B, C, D) and the lead, who integrates. It is the contract between roles that build in parallel without talking. It sits on v0.0.21 as `.run/v021-design/sheet.md` plans it and as its tag will show it built; v0.0.21 sits on v0.0.20 as `.run/v020/integrate.md`, `.run/huntfix/merged.md` and `.run/asks-v020/handoff.md` show it integrated. Where a release as built differs from its sheet, the code decides and the role says so in its handoff.

Where this sheet is silent, the docs decide: DESIGN.md and the user's rules first, then TECH §1.3, then the sections it cites, then the three lens notes it merges (`.run/v022-design/house.md`, `residuals.md`, `feel.md`; each item names its source as G*n* (house), R*n* (residuals) or FL22-*n* (feel), and "as designed" means the mechanism, constants and tests there stand unless this sheet changes them). My own choices are marked (my call). Every conflict between the three notes, and between them and v0.0.21's sheet, is settled in §0 and §4.

**Lines.** The lenses measured on three trees: the house lens on a v0.0.19 worktree and a snapshot of main mid v0.0.20 integration (the ghost), the residuals lens on v0.0.19 plus `.run/huntfix/merged.patch`, the feel lens on v0.0.19 plus the hunt's and the asks' patches (its own conflict resolution, not the integrator's). v0.0.20's integration and all of v0.0.21 move every line. So **every hunk is named by its function**, and a line is only a pointer, at main's working tree on 2026-11-16 (v0.0.20 being integrated) unless marked.

**The release.** The shoot house stays the pilot (the user, 2026-11-11: "This mission should be perfected before you spend any token on any other mission or core game mission, since most of the game will be basically this"; restated 2026-11-15). v0.0.21 made the house a test you cannot learn by heart, closed every dead end on record and said what done is. v0.0.22 finishes the house's rooms and its edges:

1. **The lane's end and the live lane (C)**: SHOW CLEAR to the instructor's eye and no standing about for your #2; paint called when it has landed; no lane word after the lane is over; one "Clear!" a man a room; the casualty's lesson by its cause; a drawn "Stack and clear, live".
2. **The kit's blast and the instinct's words (B)**: your own G-11 shielded by the jamb you stand behind, as the practice grenade's read already is; a grenade at your feet hands back "Get clear"; your #2 never into a live grenade; the frag named at the stack; words a new player can read.
3. **The rooms (A)**: the deriver as the check of every authored room plan; X4's other five rooms as chunks with derived plans; layouts B and C as named houses; the draw over all eight rooms; the role-players' posts in the chunks' frames.
4. **The page and the art (D)**: the plan view's ghost ("Again as Tier one" shows where he was); the device in your hands on the stage, chosen from a numbered sample set.

Before all four, **stage 0 (the lead)** lands everything that moves no tick: the lane's due (R5: no lane past 585 s), the house-two.js shim deleted, the new options threaded, the live lane's seam (`spotOf`) and its first pin (`house-live-pin`), two v0.0.21 saves, the anchors, the F numbers.

**Merge order**: stage 0, then A, D, B, C. A moves no cell of the set and D none at all; A may move `house-pin-drawn` cells where item 15's post rule redraws a drawn cast (§0 item 38); B moves two kit cells' saves (R1 a) and C every cell after Stop (FL22-1, FL22-4, item 18) and the live pin (FL22-2, 3, 5), so the movers merge last and each re-record is attributed to one item (§0 item 14). C's G5 half needs A's posts; C rebases onto B's merge (both edit two.js).

**Ship rules** (my calls):
- Stage 0, every item of B and C but G5, and D's ghost ship when their tests are green.
- **If v0.0.21's drawn house did not ship** (its ship rule: the drawn branch unreachable): A's first job is v0.0.21's items 1 to 4 and 16 to 18 as that sheet's A designed them, G1 ships on the set only, and G2, G3 and G5 move to v0.0.23 (the house lens's own fork, house.md's preamble). The lead decides at stage 0 step 0 and writes it in `.run/v022/lead.md`.
- **Layouts B and C** reach the picker if `house-layouts`, `house-cases`' new cases and the nets' B and C lanes are green at A's merge; else the chunks ship as data, unreachable.
- **The eight-room draw** reaches the picker's "Rooms" row if `house-drawn8` is green on the lead's quiet run and the nets' eight-room lanes meet 0 cases; its default flips to 'all' only then **and** on the user's yes (question 4).
- **A drawn live lane** is reachable (`&draw=drawn` on the live scene, the picker's row) if F80 and the drawn slice of `shoothouse-live-nodead` are green; its default stays "as set" until the user says (question 9).
- **The held device on the stage** ships on the user's scores of `samples/held-devices`, or on the defaults (G1, T1, B1, R1, C1) with the announcement saying so, if `art-held`, `look-held` and `ui-held-device` are green.

**What the user must feel.**
- Your SHOW CLEAR passed, the instructor comes along the catwalk and looks into your chamber from above you, then your #2's; the seconds your #2 spends clearing his guns pass as the hot wash's do; "The lane is clear." a breath after "Number two, clear.".
- Shot on the live lane: "I'm hit!", your #2's "Man down!", "CEASE FIRE!", and never "Keep working." a heartbeat before it; "Weapons clear. Into the booth: hot wash.", not "The lane is clear."; the lesson says what killed you: "A click with him that close: the pistol, not the tap-rack."
- Your #2 calls "Clear!" once in a room.
- The recruit's G-11 short at the door: "STACK STUNNED" no more where the jamb stood between; a G-11 at your feet: "Grenade! At your feet. Get clear.", and the DI's "Grenade! Get clear." names the row; your #2 waits for the bang before he goes in.
- "LANE B": a long room, an offset room, a room with a back room; "Move: the back room."
- "Again as Tier one": his ghost on your plan, "+5.8 s" at room 2's door.
- A G-11 in your figure's hand from the pin to the throw.

**The user's rules hold over every section:** we only know what we know; never a dead end; nothing pops in or out of view; AZERTY labels on physical codes; every image and sound by code; one loadout for every sheet; no overlapping UI; the look chosen from numbered samples the user scores; "game world is handcrafted" (2026-11-05: the five rooms are authored data, their plans proposed by a tool and committed, v0.0.21 §0 item 52's reading); the standard lane ("as set") is v0.0.21's to the byte but where this sheet names the change (R1 a, FL22-1, FL22-4, FL22-6's text, each re-pinned with its item named).

**Kept as built and starred:** "Bang" (100, 100, 100) and its four B goldens; "Pairs" (100); "Three bangs" (100); hit card B (★ 99); P3-j's band (★ 100); the tower's macros and their words; the row ids every bot, the instinct and the gauges key on (FL22-6 changes words, never an id or an act); HOUSE1's, WHEEL_S4's, the C0 grid's and X4_PLANS' goldens (`04447e988e6958`, `05f066607e544d`, `1dd12b42226e54`, `1aed1872708ea3`), and v0.0.21's `X4_CHUNK_PLANS` (reprinted only for the new families, said in CHANGELOG), `SHAPES` and `HOUSE_DRAWS` to the code; F1 to F73, never loosened.

**Rules of the round:**
- Edit only your own files and named hunks (§1). Report any other edit needed, exactly, in your handoff.
- No commits, tags, pushes, releases or promotions. Never touch `.play/`, :8200, :8201, `../longhaul` or `../tradecraft`.
- Patches and handoffs in `.run/v022/` (the user's rule: unmerged patches survive a reboot there, not in `/private/tmp`): `.run/v022/<role>.patch`, `.run/v022/<role>.md` (CHANGELOG bullets, doc text, the figures before and after, the pin's moved cells with the item that moved each, every edit outside your list, the stubs you tested against). Scratch under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/v022/<role>/`.
- Worktrees: `git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/v022-<role> v0.0.21`, `node_modules` linked from the main tree, then `git -C <wt> apply .run/v022/stage0.patch`. The roles start only once v0.0.21 is tagged and its worktrees are removed (they used 8230 to 8233). Removed at the end (unlink `node_modules`, then `git worktree remove --force`).
- Four roles share the machine: the runner with `JOBS=2`, only `QUICK=1` or a file with its separator (`'house-draw8 ›'`; `'house-drawn'` alone also runs `house-drawn8`, `house-drawn-fixes` and `house-drawn-quick`, `'house-live'` every live file, `'ui-held'` both `ui-held` and `ui-held-device`, `'house-cause'` also `house-cause-rates`). While `lsof -nP -iTCP:8200 -sTCP:LISTEN` answers and the Mac has had input in the last 5 minutes, `JOBS=1`. Heavy suites wait for the lead's quiet run (§9).
- A quick file stays under `QUICK_FILE_CPU_S` 3 s × k of CPU (v0.0.21's stage 0 enforces it); a case that would pass it moves to a heavy case of its own with "(heavy)" in its name, never into `QUICK_SLOW`.

**Ports:** A 8230, B 8231, C 8232, D 8233, reviews 8234 and 8235, the lead 8239 (stage 0, the integration, the smoke; `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT` for single browser suites; the runner claims 8240 to 8249 itself). 8236 to 8238 are left free for designers. Kill every server you start.

**Interfaces first.** Each role writes §3's exports as stubs with the shapes given, then fills them, and tests against its own stub of another role's export until that role merges. Stage 0 writes the seams' set branches, so every reader already works on the set.

**Integration.** As v0.0.21's: the stage-0 tree is the base, `B=$(cat .run/v022/base.tree)`; each role's patch is `git -C <wt> add -N . && git -C <wt> diff $B > .run/v022/<role>.patch`, but for C, whose patch is cut against the tree B's merge left (`.run/v022/after-B.tree`). The lead applies them with `git apply --3way` in the merge order, running `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` and `'house-pin ›'`, `'house-live-pin ›'` after each. Before its final run, each role rebases onto the integrated tree the roles before it left.

### The items, as built (the lens's mechanism stands but for what is said here)

1. **SHOW CLEAR to the eye** (C; FL22-1). As designed: `chiefWalk`'s point, while the tower's command is `stop` or `clear`, the catwalk point nearest the marine `inspectNext(state, H)` names (you first, unless his gun is shown first), then `path[0]`; your "Clear." (`houseReady`'s `shown`) and his "Number two, clear." wait on `chiefSees(state, H, pid)`: the instructor's eye within `SHOW_CLEAR_M` 2.5 m of the marine's chest for `SHOW_LOOK_MS` 600 ms, the start kept on `H.show = { pid, nearFromMs }` (absent until Stop; my call for the name). two.js reaches `chiefSees` only through the house's host (`hostOf(state).chiefSees`, C adding it to shoothouse.js's `registerHost('house', …)`; the null host answers true), never by import (§0 item 34): `twoAdminEnd` at a 'clear' macro's end writes `W.showOwed = at` (absent by default) in place of running `twoShown` and the line, and `twoAdminTick` runs `twoShown` and says `HOUSE_CHIEF.twoClear` on the first tick the host's `chiefSees` holds for him, deleting `W.showOwed`. `houseSecond` gains a `clear` case beside `wash`: once your gun is passed and only his macro or the look at it is owed, the activity `house-showclear` (new, a `still` like `house-wash`, its line "Your number two cleared his guns for the instructor.") runs for `twoLeftMs(state, W)` (new, two.js: the nominal ms left of his list, nothing of the instructor's) plus the instructor's walk to him (shoothouse.js, from `H.chief`'s profile), started again while owed; no stop-motion pause opens inside it. "The lane is clear." comes `WASH_AFTER_MS` 800 ms after the last "Clear.". The catwalk is house 1's, fixed, so drawn and eight-room lanes need nothing more (v0.0.21 stage 0's seam gives `houseSpecOf(state).catwalk`).
2. **Paint called when it has landed** (C; FL22-2). As designed: `liveTick` opens `LV.paintDue = { atMs, n, part, stopped, who }` at a strike, later strikes on the same marine within `PAINT_CALL_MS` 600 ms add to it, and at `atMs + PAINT_CALL_MS` one line is said if no casualty opened (`HOUSE_CHIEF.paint` for n 1, `HOUSE_CHIEF.paintTwice` for n 2, `paintStopped` for a stopped one); none if the casualty opened. `LV.said.paint` counts as now; `LV.paintDue` absent on old saves (stage 0's paint save loads over it).
3. **The lane's words end with the lane** (C; FL22-3). As designed, with one change: the wash's words are chosen by **one function**, `houseCmdSay(state, def)` (shoothouse.js, exported: `def.sayEnd.clear` when `H.end.why` is 'clear' or 'passed', `def.sayEnd.other` otherwise, `def.say` for every other command and course), read at **all three** places that pick a house command's words (§0 item 7): handling.js `onRangeCmd`'s say and `standingCmd`'s text (the nudge; on the house course), and shoothouse.js `houseOnCmd`'s `R.paUntilMs` chain, so the PA's chained length times the words said; a command posted with its own words (`R.cmd.text`) still says them. `sayEnd.clear` is the wash's `say` array itself, so on a lane ended 'clear' or 'passed' the pick, the words and the chain are v0.0.21's to the byte. `fixedLines` (ui/audio/house.js) bakes `sayEnd`'s lines with `say`'s, and the live lane's fixed lines (§0 item 6). `houseAfterStep` says nothing for a dummy cleared after `H.end` (its time still written); `casualtyTick` has your #2 say "Man down!" (`COURSES.house.opfor.manDown`) when you are the casualty; from the casualty's tick to the lane's end his "Clear!" and "Up." are not said (two.js `calloutTick` and `roomTick`'s calls, and `endLeg`'s echo, gated on `!H.live?.casualty`).
4. **One "Clear!" a man a room** (C; FL22-4). `endLeg`'s echo only when he has no call of his own in `L.calls` for that leg; `ECHO_MS` removed (its one reader). This writes fewer `L.calls` entries on turner lanes, so the pin's saves move (§0 item 11).
5. **The casualty's lesson** (C; FL22-5). As designed, `casualtyCause(state, H)` → 'click' | 'fought' | 'unseen' | 'slow' and `HOUSE_CHIEF.one` keys `casualty:click`, `casualty:fought`, `casualty:unseen` (two phrasings each; `casualty` itself stays the 'slow' words), `oneThing` scoring `casualty:<cause>` as v0.0.20's `par:<cause>`. One change: **'click' reads the DI's own rule** (a stoppage between your sighting and the fatal strike while the DI offered "Transition: pistol", i.e. the man within `specials.js TRANSITION_NEAR_M` 10 m and the P-12 holstered), never a new 5 m (§0 item 8). `TRANSITION_M` is dropped.
6. **Words a new player can read** (B and C; FL22-6). As designed; text only, every id and act unchanged. B: cqb.js's shorthand lines and the held offer gated on no pending contact, carry.js `openApproach`'s `auto` toast ("Muzzle kept off … : habit."). C: `HOUSE_CHIEF.out` ("You, out. Sit down where you are.", "Out of play. Sit down."), only if the user does not answer question 3 the other way.
7. **The blast's line** (B; R1 a). As designed: `practice.js blastLine(state, area, from, body, { y })` → `{ clear, k }`, the one reader of `fragLine`'s `wall` and `through` for a blast; `readBurst`'s `bodyRead` and `burst.js burst` (people and stands) through it: `peak = max(peakKPa(W, rM, Pa) × k, the room's QSP for a body in the burst's room)`; charges too; `standoffM` the free field's. No constant moves (`CORNER_SHADOW_K` 0.5 keeps its "to check").
8. **Get clear** (B; R1 b). As designed: in `bundle.js`'s `throw` kind, the hand-back at the feet widened from practice grenades (`DEVICES[g.model]?.as`, :1238) to every grenade, plus a failed throw whose landing puts `STUN_KPA` or more on the thrower by `blastLine`, with `SLIP_WORDS` (existing) or `SHORT_WORDS` 'Grenade short! Get clear.' (new); cqb.js's `cqb-grenade` (urgent, first of `CQB_RULES`) names `move:clear`. `tests/bots/kit.mjs` presses `move:clear` at the hand-back (the honest kit bot, as a player who reads the DI). The 'blast' fault's line is unchanged for a declined row.
9. **Your #2 and a live grenade** (B; R2). As designed: `burst.js liveIn(state, plan, path)`; one guard in `bundle.js runSlot` before a 'room:in' bundle starts, silent; `two.js twoClear` (one call in `twoTick`, ahead of his eyes), a doing 'drill:clear' that ends at the burst, his run by `bundle.js clearOf` (B exports it; private today). ## 1. Roles by file ownership

One owner per file. "Hunk" means an existing file edited in the named function only. "Anchor" means a stage-0 comment line in a shared table or at a file's end: insert only directly below your own anchor. Files not listed are the lead's, or are left alone.

## 3. Interfaces

### 3.0 Stage 0

```js
// opfor.js
spotOf(state, T) → { post, name, door, start, face, hide, dash, aimAt, why? } | undefined   // the set: OPFOR_SPOTS[T.stand]; reads T.stand only
rpStandsOf(state) → the lane's role-player stands   // drawCards' default and fillOpfor's loop; parseOpfor and opforCode keep RP_STANDS
                                                    // ['2a', '3a'] on the set
// shoothouse.js
LANE_KEEP_MS 15000, LEG_LAST_MS 45000          // COURSES.house.laneKeepMs, legLastMs; stall passes a leg by its due
// tests/game.mjs
createGame({ …, plans = null, rooms = 'a', layout = null })
// tests/opfor-world.mjs
spotCheck(state, stand, [x, z], { slot0 = null, spot, plan = null, stands = null } = {})   // moved and widened; the set's lines unchanged
```

**State**: `L.dueSaid` (additive, the leg the due passed).

### 3.1 A

```js
// combat/derive.js (pure)
derivePlan(geo, { reachM = POINT_REACH_M, holdM = JAMB_HOLD_M } = {}) → plan   // every field X4_PLANS has
holdOffs(path, jambs) → path; hotOf(geo); deadOf(geo, points); farWalkOf(geo, point, dead)
POINT_REACH_M 1.55, JAMB_HOLD_M 0.28, DERIVE_TOL { stackM 0.02, pointM 0.25, hotM 0.30, deadCentreM 0.30, deadRadiusM 0.50, farEndM 0.80, pathM 0.15, pathLenM 0.10, sectorDeg 30 }
// chunks/x4.js: each chunk as v0.0.21 plus
{ plans: { [family]: { …plan, source: 'authored' | 'derived@1' } }, posts: [{ start, face, hide, dash, why }], noStop: [{ kind, opening }] }
// assemble.js
ROOM_SETS { a: ['C', 'K', 'E'], all: ['C', 'K', 'E', 'W', 'D', 'O', 'T', 'Q'] }; SHAPE_TRIES 8
drawLazy(seed, set) → layout code; HOUSE_LAYOUTS { A: 'A', B, C }; laneWordOf(code) → 'A' | 'B' | 'C' | 'drawn'
postsOf(spec) → { [stand]: { post, name, door, start, face, hide, dash, aimAt, why } }   // memoised by the spec; post the lane room's billet (room 2: OPFOR_SPOTS['2a'].post, room 3: '3a''s)
// zones.js
ZONE_WHYS ['door', 'doorway', 'leaf', 'hatch', 'stairhead', 'crossing']; FUNNEL_GAP_MAX_M 1.5
// scenes.js
HOUSE_ROOMS_DEFAULT 'a'
```

// house-debrief.js: debriefOf(…) gains code, setup

**State**: none in the sim. Page memory only (the ghosts' list).

**Tick order** (v0.0.21's, unchanged): `houseActors` runs the #2's `runSlot` and `twoTick` (B's `twoClear` call first in it), `opforTick`, the instructor's walk (C's `chiefWalk` point); then `houseRules`: `readsTick`, the covering, `maskTick`, `traceTick` last. A paint due is said in `liveTick` on the first tick at or after its time. Decisions act the next tick.

**The build.** Stage 0 (the lead, on the v0.0.21 snapshot, nothing that moves a tick), then A (the rooms), D (the page and the art), B (the kit's blast and the instinct's words) and C (the lane's end and the live lane), merged in that order, each on its own port (8230 to 8233), then the integration (the main tree on v0.0.21's tag, port 8239; `.run/v022/integrate.md`), a play review, a code review and a fixer (`.run/v022/fix.md`, the second run on 2026-11-18). The hunt of v0.0.20's fixes (`.run/huntfix-v020/merged.md`: breach, team T1 to T4, paint and page) merged in the same tree. The release is `tools/release.sh`'s, on `main`.

**What was built, by item.** A: derive.js and the plans' check (F74), the five rooms W, D, O, T and Q as chunks with `derived@1` plans (F75), B and C as named houses, the post rule, the zones' whys (F77), the lazy draw over eight rooms (`house-drawn8`, F76). B: the blast's line for every burst, the hand-back for every grenade, the #2 waiting for the bang and getting clear (F78, F79), the frag named at the stack, the DI's shorthand. C: the instructor's eye at SHOW CLEAR and the #2's skip, paint held and said once, the lane's words by its end, one "Clear!" a man a room, the casualty's lesson by cause, the drawn live lane (F80 to F82). D: the ghost on the plan view (F83), the device in the hands (F84), the picker's House and Rooms rows, the lane's letter. Stage 0: the options (`&rooms`, `&layout`, `&plans`) and `houseChoice`, `house-live-pin`, `spotOf` and `rpStandsOf`, the shim `house-two.js` deleted, two v0.0.21 saves, the anchors and the F numbers.

**Departures from the sheet** (each a call; DESIGN.md's log of 2026-11-18 has them):
1. **The roles' worktrees were cut at v0.0.20 plus stage 0**, v0.0.21 having no tag when they began; the lead ported v0.0.21's last fixes at the integration (stage 0's departures 1 to 14, `.run/v022/lead.md`): R5 (the lane's due) and items 19 and 20 were already in the snapshot and empty here; the precedence lives in `core/debug.js` `houseChoice`, not main.js; `HOUSE_URL` takes the eight letters; `createGame` throws on an unknown house option.
2. **Three ship switches stay off**: layout C is URL only (`layouts: ['A', 'B']`), the picker has no Rooms row (`rooms: ['a']`) and the live scene draws only 'set' (`draws: ['set']`), the sheet's ship rules for F76, F80 and C's funnel faults not being met; `HOUSE_DRAW_DEFAULT` stays 'set'.
3. **Get clear takes the heading farthest from the grenade at its burst** (against §0 item 35's longest run), the held offer's gate was measured and dropped (it moved T's acts), and a slip declined stays the 'feet' fault.
4. **The casualty's wash is C's words** ("Weapons clear. Into the booth: hot wash."), v0.0.21's "The lane is closed." removed (the fixer).
5. **The sheet's §0 item 12 (the frag named, never refused) and item 21 (F37 and kit F15) hold; F25 on the mixed loadout** was red at the integration and met by the fixer: your cue ends your #2's stack-up at his stack point.

Eight quick cases moved to heavy for the CPU budgets (five of `team-hunt`'s, two of `fixer-v020`'s, one of `house-twoleg`'s), each unchanged.
7. **The ghost's clock reads "−5.8 s" for ahead of the ghost**; the sheet said "+5.8 s" (your call, question 14).
8. **The fixer's twelve**: the picker's House B played lane A; "NEW LAYOUT" and "a lane you have not seen" on a named or replayed house; "Clear!" twice and out of order; the click lesson below rung 2; FIRED FIRST's room; Again dropping the eight rooms and the plans; the best below the fold; "Good frag. 1a and 1b down."; the burst's verdict; the live lane's dropped house said in silence; the hunt's lines not baked; stale `house-two.js` comments. 14 of 14 `fixer-v022` cases fail on the tree with their fixes reversed.
